description: For every leaf input of every engine: what happens when the input arrives as 'unresolved'. 'block' = no verdict can be produced (UI shows the distinct 'cannot be determined' state). 'fallback' = a named, conservative value is substituted AND a caveat is attached to the result. Model-inferred values are never an allowed provenance.

incident_score.doc: updateScore()/calcScore() - six factors summed; P4 0-5, P3 6-10, P2 11-16, P1/Major 17+. A SUGGESTION: the tier is chosen by the user, and a score of 17+ also sets the major-incident flag regardless of the chosen tier.

users.rationale: No neutral value exists: the form's 0 / 'Unknown' scores as 'no impact', which silently LOWERS the suggested tier. (The form's 'Unknown / not assessed' = 0 is exactly the unresolved state, so it is treated as unresolved, not as an answer.)

business.rationale: No neutral value exists: the form's 0 / 'Unknown' scores as 'no impact', which silently LOWERS the suggested tier.

workaround.rationale: No neutral value exists: the form's 0 / 'Unknown' scores as 'no impact', which silently LOWERS the suggested tier. (0 means 'a workaround fully resolves impact' - a real answer, not 'don't know'.)

duration.rationale: No neutral value exists: the form's 0 / 'Unknown' scores as 'no impact', which silently LOWERS the suggested tier.

regulatory.rationale: No neutral value exists: the form's 0 / 'Unknown' scores as 'no impact', which silently LOWERS the suggested tier. (0 = 'None identified' is a claim about the world, not an absence of information.)

recurring.rationale: No neutral value exists: the form's 0 / 'Unknown' scores as 'no impact', which silently LOWERS the suggested tier.

severity_record.doc: setSev() - RECORDS the tier the user picked. The agent layer may present the engine's suggestion but may never choose or set the tier.

severity.rationale: The tier is the user's decision. The agent may show the engine's suggestion but can never choose it.

intel_hint.doc: showIntelHint() - one hint per incident type (7 of the 8 types; 'other' and '' show nothing).

incidentType.rationale: 'Not classified' is a real state in the form and shows no hint; the caveat stops that being read as 'checked, nothing to flag'.

preflight.doc: generatePreflightFindings() - completeness checks, severity-override warning, and payment / personal-data keyword scans over short description + service. Substring keyword matching: 'Refund' and 'Discard' trigger the payment warning.

shortDescription.rationale: Blank text means the payment / personal-data keyword scan has nothing to scan: the absence of a warning would be silent, so the caveat is mandatory.

observation.rationale: Blank text means the payment / personal-data keyword scan has nothing to scan: the absence of a warning would be silent, so the caveat is mandatory.

service.rationale: Blank text means the payment / personal-data keyword scan has nothing to scan: the absence of a warning would be silent, so the caveat is mandatory.

startedAt.rationale: A blank field is exactly what the pre-flight review exists to report, so treating unresolved as blank is conservative (it raises a finding).

severity.rationale: No tier means the override warning cannot fire; caveat required.

triageScore.rationale: A score of 0 makes the engine skip the override comparison; caveat required.

timelineCount.rationale: Conservative: raises the 'timeline is empty' prompt.

decisionCount.rationale: Conservative: raises the 'no decisions logged' prompt for P1/P2.

regulatoryFlagChecked.rationale: Conservative: an unset flag makes the payment / personal-data warnings fire.

change_risk.doc: calcRiskScore() - six factors summed; low <= 30, medium <= 60, high above. Since the 2026-10-10 fix, any factor left at 'Select...' shows 'Incomplete' instead of a risk level (previously: 'Low Risk - expedited review path').

blast.rationale: The form's 'Select...' (0) adds nothing to the total, so an unset factor LOWERS the risk (before the 2026-10-10 display fix, all six unset showed 'Low Risk'). No default is safe.

routing_suggestion.doc: suggestRoutingGroup() - 10 keyword rules (custom rules take priority). Highest keyword count wins, ties go to the earlier rule. The two text fields are joined WITHOUT a space before matching.

observation.rationale: The engine routes on whatever text exists; the caveat says the other field was not considered.

currency_risk.doc: assessCurrencyRisk() - certificate, vulnerability, support-status, penetration-test and patching signals. An empty list is NOT an all-clear when any input was skipped.

certificates.rationale: No certificate list means no certificate risk can be raised - an all-clear by omission. Allowed only with the mandatory caveat (output forced to complete=false).

certificates[].name.rationale: The engine prints 'unnamed' for a blank name.

certificates[].status.rationale: 'unknown' raises no risk; caveat forces complete=false.

certificates[].daysLeft.rationale: The 'expiring in N days' text needs a real number.

vulnerabilities.rationale: As for certificates: omission is not clearance.

vulnerabilities[].severity.rationale: NOT conservative to default: only critical/high are counted, so a defaulted low severity could hide one.

supportStatus.rationale: 'Not checked' is a real form state; caveat required.

lastPentest.rationale: Blank date skips the staleness check; caveat required.

lastPatched.rationale: Blank date skips the staleness check; caveat required.

sla_clock.doc: startSLAClock()/slaMins - the SLA limit for the chosen tier. The running clock itself is display-only.

severity.rationale: Without a tier there is no SLA limit.

startedAt.rationale: The tool itself warns that SLA and MTTR are incorrect without a start time; the agent path refuses to produce a limit without one.

pausedMinutes.rationale: Pauses are an adjustment on top of a valid clock; caveat tells the user none were applied.
